hub.title: PokéGuessr: Pokémon GeoGuessr
hub.description: PokéGuessr is the Pokémon GeoGuessr. You're dropped somewhere from Kanto to Paldea: look at the in-game view, drop a pin on the map and score up to 25,000 points. New daily game every day.

info.description: PokéGuessr is a free Pokémon GeoGuessr: look at an in-game view, drop a pin on the map of the Pokémon world and score up to 25,000 points.
info.intro: PokéGuessr is the Pokémon GeoGuessr: you are dropped somewhere in the Pokémon world, from Kanto to Paldea, and have to work out where.

steps.look: Look at the in-game view you are given.
steps.pin: Drop a pin on the map where you think it is.
steps.submit: Submit your guess: the closer your pin, the more points you score, up to 25,000.
steps.daily: A new daily game is available every day.

faq.a: The closer your pin is to the real location, the higher your score, up to 25,000 points.

streak.title: PokéGuessr Region Streak: name the region from one screenshot
streak.description: Region Streak is PokéGuessr's country streak: one in-game screenshot, pick the region from Kanto to Paldea. Right deals the next one, wrong ends the run. How long can you go?

globe.title: Pokémon World Globe: spin the whole Pokémon world in 3D
globe.description: A holographic 3D globe of the Pokémon world. Spin it, zoom from regions down to every town, route and landmark, watch the world grow generation by generation, and see each town in a real screenshot.

history.title: PokéGuessr duel history
history.description: Your PokéGuessr duels, casual and ranked, with a round-by-round replay of every one.
history.intro: Every duel you finish on this device, or on your account when you're signed in. Open one to replay it round by round.

replay.title: PokéGuessr duel replay
replay.description: A PokéGuessr duel, round by round: the screenshot, both pins and the true place, the scores, damage and HP.
